title.zh-TW: 首次購買滿 NT$1,000，現折 NT$200
title.en: NT$200 off a first purchase of NT$1,000 or more

text.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RT，訂單現折 NT$200；限首次購買。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Enter promo code MGMCKQ0RT at checkout for NT$200 off; first purchase only. From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會前往 amai 的邀請頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it leads to the amai invitation page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示登入或註冊 amai 會員。
steps.en: Log in or register as an amai member as the page asks.

steps.zh-TW: 選購商品，讓首次購買的訂單金額達 NT$1,000 以上。
steps.en: Shop so that your first purchase order reaches NT$1,000 or more.

steps.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RT（已包含在連結中；若結帳頁沒有自動帶入，請手動輸入），訂單即現折 NT$200。
steps.en: At checkout, enter promo code MGMCKQ0RT (already in the link; if it is not filled in, type it in) for NT$200 off the order.

intro.zh-TW: amai 首次購買訂單滿 NT$1,000，結帳輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RT，訂單現折 NT$200。
intro.en: amai online shop: on a first purchase of NT$1,000 or more, enter promo code MGMCKQ0RT at checkout for NT$200 off.

description.zh-TW:
amai 是台灣的女鞋網路商店。透過本頁連結開啟邀請頁時，優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RT 已包含在連結中；依邀請頁，好友限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$1,000（含）以上，訂單現折 NT$200。

活動期間為 2026-07-01 至 2026-12-31。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
amai is an online women’s shoe shop in Taiwan. The promo code MGMCKQ0RT is already part of the referral link on this page. Per the invitation page, an invited friend can use it only on a first purchase, and an order of NT$1,000 or more gets NT$200 off.

The campaign period is 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31. Actual terms follow amai’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RT 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫），Q 後面是數字 0。折扣限首次購買、訂單消費達 NT$1,000（含）以上，活動期間為 2026-07-01 至 2026-12-31。結帳時是否接受這組優惠碼，本站沒有實際測試，請以 amai 官方公告為準。
notes.en: Promo code MGMCKQ0RT is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization (the character after Q is the digit zero). The discount applies to a first purchase on an order of NT$1,000 or more; the campaign period is 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31. Whether checkout accepts the code was not tested on this site, so amai’s official announcements prevail.

q.zh-TW: MGMCKQ0RT 這組優惠碼在 amai 怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use promo code MGMCKQ0RT at amai?

a.zh-TW: 依 amai 的邀請頁，限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$1,000（含）以上，結帳時使用優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RT，訂單現折 NT$200。本頁連結已包含這組優惠碼；若結帳時需要輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。
a.en: According to amai’s invitation page, on a first purchase only, an order of NT$1,000 or more gets NT$200 off when you use promo code MGMCKQ0RT at checkout. The code is already part of the link on this page; if you need to type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 這個折扣是給誰的？有活動期限嗎？
q.en: Who gets the discount, and is there a deadline?

a.zh-TW: 折扣給被邀請的好友，也就是使用這組優惠碼的人，限第一筆訂單。邀請頁顯示的活動期間是 2026-07-01 至 2026-12-31，實際條件以 amai 官方公告為準。
a.en: The discount is for the invited friend who uses the promo code, and only on the first order. The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31, and actual terms follow amai’s official announcements.
